title: qiven-common-record-v1
description: Common Record v1: the minimal versioned producer envelope frozen by the P0 implementation staging batch C (ADR-0060 D3; 2026-10-02). A model view projects this record over the ten D3 dimensions (identity, observation, admission, completion, domain outcome, coverage, findings, next action, evidence, retry state). The envelope is ADDITIVE: 'payload' references the producer's EXISTING native receipt/result whose own schema stays authoritative - this record is never a second resolver or gate engine. No producer emits it at the freeze revision (producers begin at the B+D semantics + projection batch). Enum tokens are the exact ASCII-safe control vocabulary below; localized content is allowed inside free string values. EXPLICITLY UNAVAILABLE: where a dimension requires a field but the value is absent, the exact string 'unavailable' is a valid value (structured fields accept it as the alternative arm of their oneOf). EVOLUTION POLICY (ADR-0060 D7): v1 evolves additively only - a new OPTIONAL field or a new enum value requires a dated note in this description; removing, renaming or re-typing a field, or narrowing an enum, is a breaking change requiring envelope version 2 plus an explicit versioned adapter. Readers tolerate unknown fields (they record them under an unknown_fields note and never silently drop them) and reject a wrong schema_version with a typed error naming the observed and supported versions. D7 compatibility law, quoted and normative: 'Bootstrap/launcher receipts and public Operator/Workspace schemas retain their parseable contracts or migrate through an explicit versioned adapter; P0 does not silently replace JSON receipts with prose' and 'ADR-0051 router denial/law carriers stay byte-stable until an explicit public-carrier amendment'. Change log (dated notes for additive evolution): 2026-10-02 - v1 frozen (batch C); no additions yet.

schema_version.description: The envelope version; v1 is the literal integer 1.

record_kind.description: Producer-declared kind of this record, e.g. gate-run, validation, task, bootstrap-preflight.

id.description: Stable producer identifier (the p0-producer-inventory id family).

operation.description: Identity dimensions. Each field is optional-but-typed; 'unavailable' is valid where the contract requires the dimension but the value is absent ('when available' fields may simply be omitted).

coherence.description: Was the underlying observation coherent, uncertain or unavailable.

transport_classification.description: The original harness/MCP transport classification, preserved verbatim.

state.description: Known policy/invocation rejection is distinct from uncertainty.

exit_code.description: The process exit code, or the exact string 'unavailable' when explicitly absent.

collection.description: complete/partial/unknown - never an invented complete count.

findings.description: Deterministic order by (rule_id, location). Each finding carries the five required elements: stable rule ID; exact path + JSON/YAML pointer or available line; actual condition/value; expected constraint; public contract revision.

json_pointer.description: JSON pointer (/-syntax) or YAML source pointer when the parser supplies one.

action.description: Class-aware per D3: FIX/NEXT only where the mechanism mechanically knows the correction; DIAGNOSE for unexpected compiler/linker/test/crash failures; RECONCILE for unknown side effects.

supported_by.description: Required when action is FIX or NEXT: the mechanically-known correction (which field/command/rule).

layout.description: Captured-stream layout, e.g. stdout, stderr, stdout+stderr-merged, json.

reconciliation.description: Safe reconciliation route when known; never automatic mutation replay.

payload.description: Reference to the producer's EXISTING native receipt/result. The native schema stays authoritative; this envelope is additive and never a second gate engine.
